slices.summary: Using three steadier quarters as proof, Kelli wins approval to build denial prevention into front-desk onboarding rather than cleaning up mistakes after the fact. She builds a training packet with sample claims, screenshots, and common-payer scenarios showing the chain from registration error to denial. She plans to observe the first sessions as an observer (not permanent instructor), keep the core packet modular with clinic-specific inserts, and track first-month error themes.
